g.text: Comprobando el binario en el sandbox de comandos…
Off by default. The approved command runs once, unchanged. RTK filters
its captured output inside an empty, network-denied sandbox. Authority,
Sentinel, approvals and file revocations still apply.
Original output stays private and is linked by SHA-256 to the command
receipt. Savings are byte/4 estimates, not provider billing or tokenizer
measurements. A changed binary needs a new explicit opt-in.
Enter enviar · Ctrl+J nueva línea · Esc atrás ·
